name: Blood Orange (Dev Hynes)
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 trap-soul — Blood Orange (Dev Hynes)
notes: The 80s-referencing auteur-producer, and the entry gives the drum machine by name: "LinnDrum/DMX-lineage programmed kit — a gated snare on 2&4 with a long reverb, a dry electronic kick on 1 and 3, an offbeat closed hat or a straight 8th shaker, and handclaps; **no trap 808 and no triplet rolls**". So the kick has two anchors and no `secondaryAnchor`, the swing is flat at 0.50 because a LinnDrum pattern is gridded, the hat is an 8th with heavy offbeat open-hat activity, and the roll vocabulary is off entirely. ⛔ **`bass808` is null**: "a plucked, staccato, filter-enveloped analog synth bass moving in 8ths and 16ths — the 80s funk-bass idiom — or a played fretless bass; never a sustained 808" — hence `offbeat_8ths` at a low `followRootsProb`. Harmony is "among the richest entries in this section": "maj7/m9 voicings, `IMaj7–iii7–vi7–ii7` cycles, and genuine 8-bar motion with modulating bridges", so that cycle is authored as `I–iii–vi–ii` with the sevenths in `extensions`, and `maxChords` is 6. The vocal is deliberately small — "soft, thin, low-volume high tenor at very low note-density, often secondary to the instrumental" — and saxophone is the named countermelody instrument, which is why the counter's ratio is high while the lead's density is low. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are every drum number, the bassline figures and the melody density band; the entry is `[LOW-CONF]` on the exact tempo band and marks drum-machine detail as inference. ⚠ `confidence` is medium, mirroring the entry. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched.
